{{Quote|Those independent star-hoppers ''always'' modify their ships&mdash;you can't judge them by ''official classifications!''|Beilert Valance about the ''Rabbit's Foot''|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 16">[[Star Wars (1977) 16|''Star Wars'' (1977) 16]]</ref>}}
The '''''Rabbit's Foot''''' was a modified [[WUD-500 star yacht/Legends|WUD-500]] (also known as an ''N''-class freighter), owned by the [[Lepi/Legends|Lepi]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jaxxon/Legends|Jaxxon]]. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was refitted with a pair of [[Quad laser cannon/Legends|quad laser cannons]] and two [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]] for weaponry, along with improved hull plating and [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]].

Jaxxon first purchased the ship on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], but even after refitting, it was a troublesome ship to operate. Mechanical problems forced Jaxxon to land on the planet [[Aduba-3/Legends|Aduba-3]], where he was stranded until he could scrounge up replacement parts. It was on Aduba-3 that Jaxxon met [[Amaiza Foxtrain/Legends|Amaiza Foxtrain]], along with the rest of the [[Star-Hoppers of Aduba-3|Star-Hoppers]].

Jaxxon and Amaiza teamed up to make several smuggling runs with the ''Rabbit's Foot'' before being jumped by [[Beilert Valance/Legends|Beilert Valance's]] associates, [[Remel Fud]] and [[Dafi (bounty hunter)|Dafi]]. They raced Valance to Aduba-3, shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but the ''Rabbit's Foot'' was shot down in a brief firefight over the planet.

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Rabbit's Foot'' was created by [[Archie Goodwin]] and [[Walter Simonson]].
